page.notes: Printed "Secr. XI." in the right margin read as "Sect. XI." (doubtful). Marginal "Tofta" is doubtful and may be "Tostat." Marginal "A&.23.3." is a ligature and may stand for "Act." Marginal "Gembrad." is doubtful. The marginal reference for k is "A&" as printed. The asterisk mark "*" in the text is printed and is the mark of the note beside it. Dropped-cap P in "PApæ" is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to its word. Top right "P.247" and the Google digitiser stamp at lower right are excluded as not printed on this page. Some italic/roman boundaries in the body are uncertain (e.g. "Vrias", "Aaron", "Iudicis sententiam").
